Author: Soumen Sen Bench: Soumen Sen  12.09.2024  Court No.29  Item No.08  Allowed  ar  CRM (A) 2929 of 2024  In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Sectio  Criminal Procedure corresponding to Section 482 of the Bh  Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection with Asansol South P  No. 17 of 2024 dated 11.01.2024 corresponding to SPL(SC/S  2024 under Sections 420/376/406/34 of the Indian Penal Co  Section 3(e)(w) of S.C and S.T (POA) Act, 1989.
 In Re: Ashish Shaw  Petitioner  Mr. Apurba Kumar Datta For the Petitioner  Ms. Amita Gaur  Mr. Arabinda Manna For the State  1.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

2. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the nature and extent of complicity of the petitioner in the commission of the alleged offence and the fact that the relationship of two adult persons appears to be consensual in nature, we are of the view that custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not necessary.

3. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner, namely, Ashish Shaw shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.5,000/-, with two registered sureties of like amount each, subject to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also to comply with the conditions as laid down in Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 corresponding to Section 482(2) of the BNSS, 2023.

The petitioner shall meet the I.O once in a fortnight till the submission of the final report and on further condition that the petitioner shall appear before the learned Additional Sessions Judge, 1st Court, Asansol, Paschim Signed By :
CRM (A)/2929/2024 on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49707156/
1 AMITAVA ROY High Court of Calcutta 13 th of September 2024 11:58:23 AM Bardhaman, within two weeks from date in connection with SPL (SC/ST) Case No. 2 of 2024.

5. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
